image_description: A colorful baby bib lying flat on a white textured surface. The bib features vertical stripes in orange, green, and white. It has a central rectangular patch with cartoon animal illustrations (a giraffe and other figures). The bib has a curved neck opening with blue fabric ties extending from the sides. The edges are bound with orange trim.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a bib and distinguish it from similar apparel like aprons or smocks.
To verify the structural integrity of the ties and the continuous boundary of the fabric, ensuring no AI-generated fusion or floating edges.
To assess the realism of the fabric texture, stitching details, and lighting consistency on the white background.
To check if the text or symbols within the cartoon illustration are coherent or exhibit AI-generated gibberish artifacts.

focus_areas: Connection points of the blue ties to the main body
Consistency of the stripe pattern across the fabric folds
Clarity and coherence of the central cartoon illustration
Edge sharpness of the orange binding
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the central cartoon patch. AI often struggles with rendering legible text or coherent character anatomy within small printed areas on clothing. Also, verify that the blue ties attach logically to the bib's corners without melting into the background or the bib body.
